lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Si2Pd2 (Mg7SiPd) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pd centers with 12 Mg neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers adopt 12- and 14-neighbor environments. These coordination polyhedra connect through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites.
